description: Connect WIP (wip.co) or Bluesky so AimYear can post the day's progress there when the user says Post (Pro). WIP: api_key from wip.co settings. Bluesky: handle and an app password (Settings → Privacy and security → App passwords), never the account password. The login is checked, stored encrypted and never shown again. The app's connect screen usually calls this; if the user pastes a key into the chat, use it once and do not repeat it.
name: add_social_account
title: Add social account
